title: gate-marker
description: <tree>/.claude/data/gate-marker-<gate>.json: one verified pass of one gate over one exact tree state, written only by scripts/harness/gate.sh (scripts/harness/gatelib.py) after the gate exited 0 with the scope's fingerprint unchanged. Fresh while fingerprint equals the scope's current fingerprint in the same tree.

tree.description: The canonical root of the working tree the gate ran in.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 over the scope's tracked and untracked, non-ignored files.

head.description: HEAD when the gate ran; informational.
